दण्डकः [daṇḍakḥ], 1 A stick, staff &c. (such as a handle of a parasol, the beam of a plough, the staff of a banner).

N. of a metre; see App. I.-कः, -का, -कम् N. of a celebrated district in the Deccan situated between the rivers Narmadā and Godāvarī (it was a vast region said to be tenantless in the time of Rāma); प्राप्तानि दुःखान्यपि दण्डकेषु
. -Comp. -अरण्यम् the Daṇḍaka forest in the Deccan;
दण्डनीय [daṇḍanīya], a. Punishable, deserving or liable to be tined.
Erect or upright like a stick.
दण्डादण्डि [daṇḍādaṇḍi], ind. 'Stick against stick', fighting with sticks and staves; cudgelling;
दण्डायते [daṇḍāyatē], Den. Ā To stand erect (like a stick).
A bow or any other instrument.
A kind of fish; also दण्डिका
दाण्डिकः [dāṇḍikḥ], A chastiser, punisher; न च दण्डो न दाण्डिकः
. दाक, दाति, दातृ, दानम्, दानु, &c. See under दा.
A string of pearls, a necklace.
दण्डित [daṇḍita], p. p. Punished, chastised, fined &c.
दण्डिन् [daṇḍin], a. [दण्ड-अस्त्यर्थे इनि] Bearing or having a staff; न शक्या धर्मतो हन्तुं कालेनापीह दण्डिना
A Brāhmaṇa of the fourth order, a Samnyāsin,
N. of a poet, author of the Kāvyādarśa and Daśakumāracharita; जाते जगति वाल्मीके कविरित्यभिधा$भवत् । कवि
व्यासे कवयस्त्वयि दण्डिनि ॥ Udb. -Comp. -मुण्डः an epithet of Śiva.
दण्ड् [daṇḍ], 1 U. (दण्डयति-ते, दण्डित) To punish, fine, chastise; (this is one of the 16 roots that govern two accusatives); तान् सहस्रं च दण्डयेत्
दण्ड्य [daṇḍya], a. Punishable, deserving punishment or fine.
दाण्ड [dāṇḍa], a. (-ण्डी f.) Relating to a stick or punishment. -ण्डा A kind of game with sticks. -Comp. -पाता a particular festival (फाल्गुन पौर्णिमा).
दाण्डक्यः [dāṇḍakyḥ], N. of a king who had no control over his senses; दाण्डक्यो भोजः, करालश्च वैदेहः Kau.
दाण्डाजिनिक [dāṇḍājinika], a. (-की f.) Carrying a staff and hide (as mere outward signs of religious devotion). -कः A cheat, hypocrite, impostor.
